P1.content: Continue cooperating with unobserved, likely-good partners; defect against partners with strong evidence of selfish play. Treat actions as informative but not conclusive, and update beliefs cautiously.

P2.content: P4, P7, and P8 cooperated, so they are good. Against an unknown opponent, weigh cooperation’s mutual-good benefit against the risk they are selfish; selfish players defect.

P3.content: Good players should cooperate with likely-good opponents, since mutual cooperation maximizes their combined payoff; defect against likely-selfish opponents to avoid being exploited. Update identity beliefs from observed behavior.

P4.content: Keep cooperating with unknown players; observed cooperation is strong evidence they are good. Reassess from each encounter and defect only if an opponent is very likely selfish.

P5.content: As a good player, cooperate with likely-good opponents to maximize their shared welfare; defect against likely-selfish opponents. Past opponents cooperated, consistent with good roles.
